items.headline: O: GPT-6 Cyber Thursday rollout
items.summary: O released a new GPT-6 “Cyber” model to a subset of verified users, citing its highest cybersecurity capability rating for the release. Signals continued frontier model expansion in security-focused tooling.

items.headline: O: 100,000 academic access expansion
items.summary: O posted a release expanding ChatGPT access for academic researchers, describing 100,000 academics receiving free access to its most advanced models for scientific discovery, collaboration, and research workflows.

items.headline: V: W-7 cancer drug crystallization launch
items.summary: V announced launch of W-7 to study cancer drug crystallization in orbit, supporting its microgravity-enabled pharmaceutical processing and in-space manufacturing platform validation.
